translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Jusaman pitapis mana tunisinansipä Jesucristo tantyasishgan
Nircurna discïpuluncunata Jesús nergan: “Jusalicunayquita Tayta Diosninsi mana munaptinpis jusaman tunisicogcuna imaypis cayangami. ¡Paycunaga juicio finalcho fiyupami laquicongapä!
Tayta Diosman yäracogcunata jusalicasiyaptenga más alimi canman mulïnu rumita cuncanman sheguparcur lamarman garpuriyaptinpis.
Cuidä gamcunapis jusaman tunisicogcunano cayanquiman. “Tayta Diosman yäracog mayiqui imalachöpis rabianäsishuptiquega jusalicuycashganta tantyasinqui. Tantyasiptiqui chasquicuptenga perdonanqui.
Juc junagcho ganchis cuti rabianäsishuptiquipis: ‘Perdonaycalämay’ nishuptiquega perdonanqui.”
Sayno niptin apostolnincuna Jesusta niyargan: “Yanapaycayämay Tayta Diosninsiman más yäracur runa mayëta nishgayquino perdonayänäpä.”
Sayno niptinmi Jesús nergan: “Ñäbuspa murunno tacshalapis yäracuyniqui captenga cay jatuncaray sicómoro jachata: ‘Sapipita luquicarcur lamarman jawicämuy’ niyaptiquipis jawicämongami.”
Tayta Diosninsi nimashgansita ashmaynöla cäsucunansipä cashgan
“Ashmaynincuna arushganpita o misicushganpita chaptin manami pipis ashmayninta: ‘Jamayculay micuyänayquipä’ ninsu.
Saypa trucanga lapanpis niyan: ‘Yanucamuyrä garamänayquipä. Micusquiptërämi gamga micunquipä.’
Mandashganta ruraycaptinpis manami ‘Päquilä’ ninsu say ashmayninta.

“Ashmaynölami gamcunapis caycäyanqui. Saymi Tayta Diosninsi munashganta rurarpis ama shuyacuyanquisu pipis: ‘Alitami rurashcanqui’ niyäshunayquita. Saypa trucanga niyay: ‘Nogacunaga Tayta Diosninsipa ashmayninmi caycäyä. Saymi munashgalanta ruraycäyä.’ ”
Leprawan gueshyaycag chunca runacunata Jesucristo aliyäsishgan
Jerusalenpa aywarmi Jesús päsargan Samaria y Galilea provinciacuna cuchulanpa.
Tacsha marcaman chänanpä caycaptinmi leprawan gueshyaycag chunca (10) runacuna payta ricayargan. Saymi carulapitana gayacuyargan:
“¡Tayta Jesús, nogacunata cuyapaycayälämay!” nir.
Saymi Jesús nergan: “Aywayay cüracunaman ricayäshunayquipä.” Sayno niptin aywaycäyashgalanchöna aliyäyargan.
Saymi aliyashganta tantyaycur juc cutergan Jesús cagman Tayta Diosninsita alabaraycar.
Chaycurnami gongurpacuycorgan Jesuspa puntanman: “¡Päquilä, taytay!” nishpan. Say cuteg runaga cargan Samariapitami.
Saymi Jesús nergan saycho cag runacunata: “Leprapita aliyagcunaga ¿manacu chuncag (10) cayargan? ¿Maytä waquin cäga?
Waquin cag Israel runa caycarpis aliyashganpita Tayta Diosta alabayänanpä manami cutiyämushgasu. Cay runami isanga, mana Israel runa caycarpis, cutimush Tayta Diosninsita alabananpä.”
Nircur say runata nergan: “Cananga aywacuyna. Tayta Diosman yäracushgayquipitami salvashgana caycanqui.”
Jesucristupa cutimuynin imano cananpä cashgan
Juc cutimi Jesusta fariseucuna tapuyargan: “Israel runacunapa mandagnin Cristo chämunanpäna caycashganta ¿imanöpatä musyayäman?”
Sayno tapuptin nergan: “Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo chämunanpäna caycashganta manami lapan runacunasu tantyacuyanga.
Manami pipis nengasu maychöpis caycashganta. Saypa trucanga Tayta Diosninsi cachamushgan Cristo gamcunawannami caycan.”
Saypita más rätuntanami discïpuluncunata nergan: “Gloriaman aywasquiptë gamcuna segaypami munayanqui jucla noga cutimunäta. Sayno munayaptiquipis manami jucla cutimushäsu.
Pipis: ‘Saychömi o wacchömi Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo caycan’ nishuptiquipis ama cäsuyanquisu.
Wiscurcuna shuntacagta ricarmi musyansi wanush uywa saycho jitaraycashganta. Saynölami cay nishgäcuna päsaycagta ricar musyayanqui noga cutimunäpäna caycashgäta.
Sayno manarä captinmi puntataga runacuna chiquimar segaypa nacasimanga.
“Noé cawanan wisan diluvio elagpita cashgannömi nogapis elagpita cutimushäpä.

Noé cawanan wisanpis runacunaga micur, upyar y majasacarmi caycäyargan. Sayno cawayargan arcaman Noé yaycushgan junagyagmi. Sayno caycaptinmi elagpita fiyupa tamyar cay pasaman yacu juntargan. Saynöpami lapan runacuna shengaypa wanur ushacäyargan.
Saynölami Lot cawanan wisanpis runacuna micur, upyar, rantir, ranticur, murupacur y wayitapis sharcasir caycäyargan.
Sodoma marcapita Lot yargusquiptinnami ciëlupita tamyamorgan azufriyog nina. Saychömi lapan runacuna rupaycar wanuyargan.
Saycuna elagpita päsashgannömi nogapis elagpita cutimushäpä.
“Say junäga wayinpita wagtacho caycagcuna ama wayinman yaycuyäsunsu imancunata jorguyänanpäpis. Saynöla chacracho caycagcunapis wayinman amana cutiyäsunsu.
Cuidä Lotpa warmin
Diosta mana cäsucog cashganno gamcunapis cayanquiman.
Tayta Diosta cäsucunanpa trucan quiquin munashganno cawacuyta munagcunaga manami pipis gloriaman chäyangasu. Tayta Dios munashganno cawag cagcunami isanga gloriaman char imayyagpis cawayangapä.
“Cutimushgä junagmi juc cämalacho ishcag punuycagpita chasquicamag cagta apacushä y mana chasquicamag cagtanami cacharishä.
Maraycho ishcay warmicuna agacuycagcunapita chasquicamag cagta pushacushä y mana chasquicamag cagtanami cacharishä.
[Chacracho ishcay runacuna aruycagpita nogaman yäracamag cagtami apacushä y mana yäracamag cagtanami cacharishä.]”

Sauraga sayta wiyaycur discïpuluncuna tapuyargan: “Sayno shuntashgayqui höra nogacuna ¿maychötä cayäshä, taytay? ¿Gamwancu o manacu?” Sayno tapuyaptinmi Jesús nergan: “Wiscurcuna uywa wanush caycagman juntacäyashgannömi gamcunapis noga cashgä cagcho shuntacash cayanquipä.”

footnotes.text: Jesús runala cashganta yarpar fariseucuna manami tantyayargansu Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo Jesús cashganta.
Lotpa warmin Diosta mana cäsucushganta musyanayquipä liyinqui Génesis 19.17,26.
